design.unit_definition: 反復（Rep1–Rep3。独立性は出典で確認できない）
design.pairing_basis: 同じ反復（Rep）の未処理と Cisplatin 10 µM

channel_gate.statistic: arithmetic mean of raw channel intensity within each adopted nucleus
channel_gate.threshold_rule: mean strictly greater than threshold; equality is negative

acquisition.note: User-confirmed acquisition basis; no intensity normalization or batch adjustment.

method_settings.contrast_policy: all declared contrasts regardless of omnibus p
method_settings.posthoc_label: planned pairwise tests; neither Dunn nor Games–Howell
